description: Ready briefing for one match (any sport but cricket): form, current streaks, home and away records, head-to-head, table position and gaps, stakes, schedule; for soccer also injuries, lineups, players one league appearance or goal short of a club milestone (milestone_next) and, after the match, the story (comeback, late winner, red cards), runs it ended (streak_ended_*: 'first defeat after 11 unbeaten') and long waits it ended that our data can date (first_since_*: first win at the opponent's ground, first clean sheet, top of the table for the first time since a day; history_from: nothing is claimed before it). The head-to-head block has goals and each side's biggest win. Soccer before kickoff: players suspended (suspended_out) or one booking from a ban, by the league's card rules. Each statement also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr), and summary: the most important sentences as one paragraph in that language. Facts only, no predictions. Insights feature. Prefer this for 'tell me about this match'.

format.description: md for a short Markdown text instead of JSON

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

name: get_match_briefing
